description.en_US: Post the same captions and media to Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and X in parallel. Captions cycle; each media item is used once per channel.
description.zh_CN: 用同一套文案与素材并行发到 Facebook、Instagram、Threads、TikTok、X。文案循环使用；每个素材在渠道内只用一次。
description.zh_TW: 用同一套文案與素材並行發到 Facebook、Instagram、Threads、TikTok、X。文案循環使用；每個素材在渠道內只用一次。
description.ja_JP: 同一のキャプションと素材を FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X に並列投稿。キャプションは循環、素材はチャネル内で1回のみ。
description.ko_KR: 동일 캡션·소재를 FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X에 병렬 게시. 캡션 순환, 채널 내 소재 1회 사용.
description.th_TH: โพสต์ข้อความและสื่อชุดเดียวกันไป FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X แบบขนาน วนข้อความ สื่อใช้ครั้งเดียวต่อช่องทาง
description.id_ID: Posting caption & media yang sama ke FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X secara paralel. Caption berulang; media sekali per kanal.
description.ms_MY: Siar teks & media sama ke FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X secara selari. Teks berulang; media sekali setiap saluran.
description.vi_VN: Đăng cùng nội dung & media lên FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X song song. Nội dung lặp; media dùng một lần mỗi kênh.
description.de_DE: Gleiche Texte und Medien parallel auf FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X. Texte zyklisch; Medien einmal pro Kanal.
description.es_ES: Misma copia y medios en paralelo en FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X. Textos en ciclo; medios una vez por canal.
description.pt_BR: Mesmos textos e mídias em paralelo no FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X. Textos em ciclo; mídia uma vez por canal.
description.fr_FR: Mêmes textes et médias en parallèle sur FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X. Textes en cycle ; médias une fois par canal.
description.ru_RU: Одни тексты и медиа параллельно на FB/IG/Threads/TikTok/X. Тексты по кругу; медиа один раз на канал.

flowChart.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  start([填写文案与素材]) --> pick[勾选浏览器]
  pick --> route{按平台分组}
  route -->|无可发平台| empty([结束：请选支持的浏览器])
  route -->|已分组| pair[按素材生成帖 · 文案循环]
  pair --> parallel[各浏览器并行发帖]
  parallel --> one{单帖是否成功}
  one -->|失败| note[记录失败并继续]
  one -->|成功| wait[等待全部结束]
  note --> wait
  wait --> done([汇总成功失败跳过])
